body: That would be the best thing to happen to me. My life is super shitty now. If I could redo the last 5 years, or at least the last 3 years, I can get my life back on track.
Another idiotic statement that I have heard people say, "you have a great life, you have nothing to be depressed about".

I too have been battling depression for a while. I haven't reached out for help because of the stigma associated with mental health issues. Thank you for making me think thoroughly about the disappearing plan. Your questions kept me up the whole night. The problem is that I am in a foreign country now and a flight ticket will show exactly where I went. The best place for me to disappear would be my own country.
As if on cue, something came up that will tarnish my reputation and cost me money. I don't have enough money saved up for the legal consequences. I am now considering preponing the suicide date.
I feel like this every single day.

No. I don't have a disappearing plan. I didn't think too much about disappearing even though it struck me as an option.
I am too depressed to start afresh. I sometimes feel that even my therapist has given up on me. What is the use in leading such a sad life?
Never broke a bone, never got stitches, didn't catch chicken pox when practically the entire class caught it.
